problem_statement: The devicetree API provides DT_STRING_TOKEN_BY_IDX() and DT_INST_STRING_TOKEN_BY_IDX(), which return the string-array token at a given index, but they have no way to supply a fallback when the requested index is out of range. Two new helper macros are required: DT_STRING_TOKEN_BY_IDX_OR(node_id, prop, idx, default) and DT_INST_STRING_TOKEN_BY_IDX_OR(inst, prop, idx, default). Each must return the token at the given index when that index exists in the property, and otherwise expand to the supplied default value. For a node/instance whose string-array property has only a few valid elements, an in-range index must yield the real token while an out-of-range index must yield the default.
